data.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Caturmasya,’ which refers to the four auspicious months of the Hindu calendar. The name signifies the blessings and grace of the gods during these holy months. It is believed that a child named Cm will be blessed with good fortune and prosperity throughout their life. The name Cm carries the meaning “God's grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Cm usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
